label: KGhost
description: Race against a ghost on your Karoo: a fixed-pace Ghost Pace or your own past self on a route, stitched into one continuous ghost. Shows the live time/distance gap on graphical and numeric data fields and draws the ghost's position on the map. Records each ride automatically and can import GPX/FIT ghosts dropped in /sdcard/KGhost. Keeps estimating during GPS dropouts.
releaseNotes: On a route you have barely ridden before, the ghost now races your Ghost Pace target instead of sitting at 0 for the whole ride; once you have enough history on the route it races your past self again. Until there is something to compare you with, the gap shows --- instead of a misleading 0, and the SEG/GP tag now tells you which one you are racing (SEG = your past self, GP = the Ghost Pace target).
